title: The Ground Between Them
summary: Niamh rides into ruined Ireland to bring Oisin home. He has already touched the ground. They stand nine steps apart and cannot cross to each other.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the collapsed ring-fort under a low grey sky, moss on the fallen stones, bare thorn trees. Nothing moves but the grass. Static camera.
Wide shot. The warrior walks forward between the fallen stones with long strides, small against the ruin, cloak swinging. He does not stop.
Wide shot. The princess walks into the frame from the far edge, crossing the open ground toward the ruin with steady strides, golden hair bright against the grey.
Wide shot. The princess stops and stands still on the open ground, small in the frame, the fallen stones between her and the far side.
Close shot. The princess's face, grey light on her, holding his eye. She does not look away. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You said you would not get down. You said it on the shore with your hand on the bridle, and I believed you, because I have never once known you to lie.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face, grey light on him, taking his time before he answers. Static camera.

dialogue.line: There was a stone in the field and two men could not lift it. I have lifted heavier. I did not think. Three hundred years undone in the time it takes to bend.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. She puts out her hand toward him and holds it there. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then take my hand. The horse remembers the way even if you do not. It is nine steps. I have counted them from here.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face, grey light on him. He looks down at his own hands and then back up. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Niamh. Look at my hands. They were young when I bent down. I am not going to be able to reach you.

scenes.visual: Split panel. Two faces held side by side in one frame, a hard line between them, neither speaking. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face, wet-eyed and steady, grey light on her. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I will come back to this shore every year until the sea takes it. You will not be here. I will come anyway.

scenes.visual: Wide shot. The princess turns and walks away from the ruin toward the far edge of the frame with long strides, growing smaller. She does not look back.
Close shot. The warrior's face alone, grey light going, speaking to ground that has nobody on it. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Go on, then. Before I have the chance to ask you to stay, and you have the chance to say no.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot. The warrior small and alone among the fallen stones, the light going out of the sky behind him. Nothing moves.
